comment: It’s always smart to wait for the draw to be released and compare it to the latest weather forecast before this tournament starts, but I’m going to want to avoid what I did last week in removing Chris Gotterup from my original lineup for defensive purposes. What a stupid I was.

expert_title: Senior Manager, TOUR & Golfbet Editorial & Distribution
comment: Last year was the first time in nearly a decade that Cantlay finished worse than T11 at Pebble Beach. Expect him to start a new streak this week.
I should captain McIlroy, but I'm chasing. The Aussie runs hot here and will be up for his annual battle. With 13 top 25 results in 15 visits, I am on board.
Once Hovland gets any indication in his head that he’s figured things out, I will jump on the chance to maximize my points on him. I was encouraged by what we saw in Scottsdale.
Easy choice to break the seal on McIlroy in his season debut as defending champion. Hoping the return to blades helps him locate these small greens.
